Thanks for the intro earlier. Our execs are excited to see Redwood Inference in action but coordination across APAC, EU and US is proving tricky. High level:

Hi Suzanne —

Thanks — this is doable. A couple of constraints to flag up front:
1) Europe has a DST forward shift at the end of this month which tightens the overlap window for early-April — CET/CEST transitions make 15:00 CET ambiguous if we don't anchor to a timezone.
2) Our CTO time is limited mornings PDT; we should avoid scheduling before 07:30 PDT.

I'll propose two concrete windows (times shown in local zones):
- Option Alpha (shortest late-evening for APAC): 07:30 PDT / 16:30 CEST / 23:30 SGT (30 min exec slot)
- Option Beta (earlier EU-friendly): 09:00 PDT / 18:00 CEST / 01:00 SGT (rotating presenters, wrap by 45 mins if needed)

Also propose a 15-min prep the day before with engineering and your Head of Product. I'm attaching a quick availability matrix for our execs; can you add your constraints to it?

Best,
Nikhil
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415 555 0173

Attachment: exec_availability_matrix.xlsx
